title: feat(console): a save's toast shows the notice a hook set on the write, one toast per write
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao7psmQXENcMMMPyS21PpPWj)_

Fixes #28252
Refs #28000

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@object-ui/data-objectstack`'s `WriteWarningEvent` gains an optional `notice`; `@object-ui/react` gains the type `RecordSaveFeedback`, `AnswerWarningsEvent` gains an optional `notice`, and `AnswerWarningClaim.take` / `toastRecordSave` move to it. Those two were added by #28267 and have not been released, so no released signature changes)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：保存记录时，如果服务端钩子给这次保存留了一句话（`notice`，比如「已提交给经理审批」），控制台现在会显示它。记录弹窗（含子表单任务）、整页表单、`object-form` 抽屉/弹窗、表格行内编辑（单行保存和「全部保存」）都在原来的保存提示里把这句话放在标题下面；仍然只弹一个提示。
- 为什么改：#28000 的契约半边（#28247）已经让创建/更新的应答带上 `notice`，但控制台没有任何地方读它，HotCRM「保存即送审」的提示被丢掉了（#28252）。适配器原本只把应答里的记录交出去，`notice` 在那一层就被丢了。
- 风险与回滚：适配器 `create`/`update` 返回值不变，只是写入提醒事件多带一个可选字段；只有提醒的保存仍是成功样式，同时有警告时才是警告样式。没有页面认领的写入（例如记录详情页行内编辑的保存条）由写入提醒通道弹一个 info 提示。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/react/src/record-save-feedback.ts`（`take` 交回 `RecordSaveFeedback`，`toastRecordSave` 的样式选择）；`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`（行内保存新增认领，「全部保存」按行认领再合并成一个提示）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts`（未被认领时通知的落点）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/react/src/record-save-feedback.test.ts packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/inlineEditSaveNotice-28252.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Which surfaces show the notice** (the card's should-fix (b)), one toast per write in every row:

| Surface | Toast |
|:---|:---|
| Record dialog (`AppContent` `crud_success`) and its child-form task | its record-named message, the notice under it |
| Full-page form (`RecordFormPage`) | its record-named message, the notice under it |
| `object-form` drawer and modal (`ObjectFormContainer`) | its record-named message or declared `successMessage`, the notice under it |
| Grid inline edit, per-row save and "Save All" (`ObjectGrid`) | "1 row saved" / "N rows saved", the notices under it (distinct, one per line) |
| Any write no surface claims (the record page's inline-edit Save bar, which raises no save toast of its own; kanban, actions, …) | the write-warning channel's own toast: an info toast with the notice as written, or the notice leading the "Saved — with warnings" lines |

A notice alone keeps the save toast on the success variant (it reports an outcome, never a problem); with warnings too, the toast is the warning variant and the notice leads its lines. The stripped-fields toast stays its own toast, as before.

**The adapter** (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`). Measured: `create` / `update` resolved `result.record` and read only `droppedFields` and `warnings` off the answer, so `notice` was dropped there. `notifyDroppedFields` now also reads `notice` (a non-empty string, else nothing) onto the write-warning event, and emits the event when the notice is the answer's only news. What the two methods resolve is unchanged. The batch path is not touched: the spec declares `notice` on the single-record answers only.

**The claim** (`ui/packages/react/src/record-save-feedback.ts`). `AnswerWarningsEvent` gains `notice`; `take(saved)` returns `RecordSaveFeedback` (`warnings`, optional `notice`, the last one parked winning as on the server); `toastRecordSave(sink, message, feedback)` titles the toast with the surface's message and puts the notice, then the warnings, under it.

**The channel** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts`). `emitWriteWarning` parks when the event carries warnings or a notice, still synchronously before its first `await`. Unclaimed, the notice is one toast as the table says. `WriteWarningSink` gains `info`; sonner's `toast`, which `AdapterProvider` passes, has it. The type is not exported from the package.

**The surfaces.** `AppContent`, `RecordFormPage` and `ObjectFormContainer` hand `take`'s result to `toastRecordSave` (the `crud_success` params carry `notice` beside `warnings`). `ObjectGrid`'s default row save opens a claim on the row's update for the length of the save, and "Save All" one per row, read once into the single toast, released in a `finally`.

## Tests

New:

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/inlineEditSaveNotice-28252.test.tsx` (3): per-row save shows one success toast with the notice, the channel nothing; "Save All" over two rows shows one warning toast, the shared notice once then the warning line; CONTROL: a write the grid did not make keeps the channel toast after the save.
- Added cells to `onWriteWarning.test.ts` (3: create and update carry the notice and still resolve the record; empty or non-string notice emits nothing), `record-save-feedback.test.ts` (3), `writeWarningToast.test.ts` (5: claimed update and create take it; unclaimed notice alone is one info toast; beside warnings it leads the one warnings toast; a released claim shows it), `RecordFormPage.saveToastCarriesWarnings-27999.test.tsx` (3), `AppContent.recordSaveOneToast-27999.test.tsx` (4) and `containerSaveToastCarriesWarnings-28216.test.tsx` (4, drawer and modal).
- Updated: the existing `take` and `toastRecordSave` assertions read the new object shape; their meaning is unchanged.

**Ablation** (through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each mutation proved on disk and restored to the HEAD blob):

- channel parks on warnings only → 5 notice cells red across `writeWarningToast`, `RecordFormPage` and `AppContent` (the notice-with-warning cells stay green, as predicted: the warnings still open the park);
- adapter drops `notice` from the event → 7 red across `onWriteWarning` and `writeWarningToast`;
- grid per-row save toasts without `take` → 2 red in the new grid file (the per-row cell, and its CONTROL, whose count includes the notice the unread claim hands back).

## Acceptance notes

- The record page's inline-edit Save bar (`InlineEditSaveBar`) raises no save toast at all today, so it is not a claiming surface; its notice reaches the user through the channel's info toast, which is one toast per write. Giving that bar a save toast of its own is outside this card.
- "Save All" joins distinct notices from several rows one per line under one toast; rows with the same notice show it once.
- Not measured live in a browser against a hook that sets `onNotice`; the server half that lets sandboxed and flow hooks set it is #28251. The chain is pinned through the real adapter (`writeWarningToast.test.ts`), the real `RecordFormPage` / `AppContent` / `ObjectFormContainer` / `ObjectGrid` save paths in jsdom.

## Verification
